title: Funding Methods, ACH Holds and Withdrawal Fees Across Paloma Business Plans
content:
A Paloma Business account holds a US dollar balance. Each plan sets the largest balance the account may hold (deposits beyond it are returned), the ways the business may fund the balance, the fees on debit-card and wire deposits, the Paloma business days an ACH deposit is held before it can fund payouts, the fee for a withdrawal to the business's US bank account beyond the free ones, and the number of free withdrawals per billing period.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Largest balance (USD) | 50000.00 | 150000.00 | 500000.00 | 1500000.00 | 4000000.00 | 10000000.00 |
| Deposit methods | ACH credit, debit card | ACH credit, wire, debit card | ACH credit, wire, debit card | ACH credit, wire, debit card | ACH credit, wire, debit card | ACH credit, wire, debit card |
| Card deposit fee (percent of a debit-card deposit) | 2.90 | 2.90 | 2.50 | 2.50 | 2.20 | 2.00 |
| Wire deposit fee (USD per incoming wire) | 0.00 | 10.00 | 5.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| ACH hold (Paloma business days) | 5 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Withdrawal fee (USD per withdrawal beyond the free ones) | 2.50 | 2.50 | 2.50 | 2.50 | 2.50 | 2.50 |
| Free withdrawals per billing period | 1 | 3 | 5 | 10 | 25 | 100 |

### Schedule Q&A

**Can a Paloma Business Starter account be funded by wire?** No. Its deposit methods are ACH credit and debit card; the wire fee figure of 0.00 on that plan has no deposit to apply to.

**Which plans carry a wire deposit fee above zero?** Paloma Business Essentials, at 10.00 USD per incoming wire, and Paloma Business Growth, at 5.00 USD.

**Is the withdrawal fee the same on every plan?** Yes, 2.50 USD per withdrawal beyond the free ones; the number of free withdrawals per billing period differs by plan.

**What does the largest balance mean for a deposit?** A deposit that would take the balance beyond the plan's largest balance is returned.
